note: Both sets contain identical major engineering errors, specifically misbinding members (C3X6, HSS4X6, W6X20) to the West Elevation when they belong to North, East, or South elevations. Both sets suffer from significant duplication (e.g., listing the same member as both 'component' and 'framing member') and vague entity naming ('member', 'component'). Set B includes one claim bound to the sheet title which is slightly more grounded than Set A's unbound equivalent, but this does not outweigh the shared errors.
